sub: high protein · vegan with eggs · thyroid-friendly
cycleNote: The same week repeats. Monday and Friday are medium, Wednesday is the higher-carb day, and the other days are low. Put the higher-carb day on the heaviest strength session.

tierText.LOW: About 72 g. Plant protein, eggs, non-cruciferous vegetables and healthy fats, with at most one small fruit or starch side.
tierText.MED: About 82 g. The same base plus one carb side such as quinoa, sweet potato or fruit.
tierText.HIGH: About 90 g. Base plus oats or quinoa, sweet potato and fruit around training. One day a week.

rules: EAT
var(--p)
Plant protein: tofu, tempeh, edamame, seitan, lentils, chickpeas, black beans, pea protein powder, nutritional yeast
Eggs and egg whites in moderation
Non-cruciferous vegetables: spinach, bell peppers, zucchini, mushrooms, tomatoes, carrots, green beans, asparagus, cucumber, lettuce, eggplant, celery
Healthy fats: olive oil, avocado, almonds, walnuts, chia, flax, hemp, tahini, pumpkin seeds
Carbs: oats, quinoa, brown rice, sweet potato, sprouted bread, berries, apples, bananas, oranges
Water 2.5 to 3 L a day
LIMIT
var(--c)
Whole eggs: 2 or fewer a day and 8 or fewer a week
Soy foods (tofu, tempeh, edamame): no more than 2 soy meals a day, and keep them 4 hours away from levothyroxine
Legumes: about 40 g of carbohydrate per cup, so portions are measured
Seitan contains gluten. Swap it out if she is gluten-sensitive
Raw spinach in moderation, about 2 cups at a time
NOT USED
var(--keto)
Cruciferous vegetables: broccoli, cauliflower, kale, cabbage, Brussels sprouts, bok choy, radishes, arugula
Dairy: paneer, yogurt, cottage cheese, whey protein, ghee, butter
Meat, poultry and fish
Highly processed soy products and soy protein isolates
Added sugars and sweetened drinks
monitoring: Weigh in once a week, same time, same day, fasted, and track the 7-day average. At 15 lb in 3 months the target is about 1.25 lb a week. If loss runs faster for more than two weeks, raise calories by 100.
Take thyroid medication (e.g. levothyroxine) on waking with water only and wait 30 to 60 minutes before eating or coffee. Keep soy, iron and calcium 4 hours away from the medication.
Repeat TSH and free T4 with the physician at about 8 to 12 weeks. Watch energy, sleep, hair, mood and cold tolerance. If they get worse, review calories with the physician.
never: Cruciferous vegetables: broccoli, cauliflower, kale, cabbage, Brussels sprouts, bok choy, radishes, arugula
Dairy: paneer, yogurt, cottage cheese, whey protein, ghee, butter
Highly processed soy products and soy protein isolates
limitNote: Whole eggs are capped at 2 a day and 8 a week. Tofu, tempeh and edamame count as soy: no more than 2 soy meals a day, and keep them 4 hours away from levothyroxine.
tierNote: Low days use base meals only. Medium days add one carb side. The higher-carb day adds oats, quinoa, sweet potato or fruit.
checkSuffix: · no cruciferous vegetables, dairy, meat or fish.

swapLimits: The egg limits (2 a day, 8 a week) and the soy limit (2 soy meals a day) stay in force. A swap that breaks one shows a red warning.
footer: Macros are estimates from standard food-composition values and can vary by 5–10%. Review calories, supplements and soy timing with the treating physician, especially while levothyroxine is being adjusted.
groceryNote: Dry grains are listed as dry measure. Sweet potato is weighed baked. Buy tofu and tempeh in whatever pack size is closest.
